title: ArtifactCardData
description: Generated-artifact viewer payload: a framed preview plus the source files behind it. A deliberately NARROW subset of the Artifact component's props — it says WHAT to show, never how the viewer behaves. Toolbar composition, view-state and the iframe `sandbox` are host-owned and stay off the wire, so a model cannot widen its own sandbox or hide the chrome the user needs to inspect what it built.

src.description: URL the preview iframe frames, and the target of the Home button. Omit for a source-only artifact (`tab: 'code'` with `files`).

files.description: Files behind the artifact: the Code tab's tree, each optionally carrying its own preview url and source.

path.description: Tree label/key. Folders are built from `/`-delimited segments.

url.description: Where the preview loads this file. Defaults to `path` resolved against `src`.

code.description: Source shown in the Code tab. Omit for binary files (image/pdf), which have no code view.

type.description: File kind. Drives the tree icon and whether the Code view applies; 'pdf' also routes the preview to the inline PDF viewer.

additions.description: Lines added vs the base. Rendered as a trailing '+N' stat.

deletions.description: Lines removed vs the base. Rendered as a trailing '-N' stat.

status.description: Change status vs the base. Drives a trailing status letter in the conventional VCS hue.

tab.description: Which view the card OPENS on. SEED ONLY: the user can switch freely afterwards and a revision of this card will NOT move them back, because the user's choice wins over the model's. A switch is reported back as a `state` patch.

activeFile.description: Path of the file selected in the tree when the card FIRST renders (must match a `files[].path`). Seeds the tree highlight, the Code source and the preview. SEED ONLY, like `tab`: revising this card will not move a user who has since selected a different file.

displayUrl.description: Friendly address shown in the path field INSTEAD of the real url, which also makes the field read-only. Use when `src` is not consumer-facing (e.g. a `data:` blob) so a clean address is shown rather than leaking it.

height.description: Frame height. A bare number is px; a string is any CSS length. Defaults to 420px. REQUIRED CONCEPT, not decoration: the viewer is built to fill its container, and a message thread supplies no height, so the card sets one explicitly or the artifact collapses to zero and renders invisible.
